body:
Joins the coven fight and casts a spell on a wounded fellow hag.

Recorded role and choices

During the April 2025 confrontation, Maritxu threatens the company and approaches a dying fellow hag to cast a spell, urging the pair to finish the adventurers. The scene records active cooperation in the fight. It does not name the spell, prove a successful restoration or establish Maritxu’s later fate.
